jobs.program: Summer Clerkship — 2027 NSW recruitment cycle (clerkships commencing late 2027/early 2028)
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, but the Law Society lists two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027) depending on the employer, so no single scheme-wide close date can be confirmed; eligibility is generally penultimate-year students.

The firm's own careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but gives only the month — no exact open or close dates are published yet, and state-based dates will follow the relevant Law Society/LIV/QLS guidelines.
